Yes, that matches what the parentheses mean to me. Typing `rome (#article or #book)` gave me the two Rome bookmarks — the one labeled Article and the one labeled Book — and left out the Florence article even though it's an article, because it isn't about Rome. So it read it as "must be about Rome, and also be either an article or a book," with the parentheses keeping the either/or grouped together. That's exactly the grouping I'd want.

Now the last pieces I wanted to see: putting something in quotes to match it as an exact phrase, and quoting a command word like "and" so it's treated as a plain search word instead of an operator.
